title: 京张近端 · 近端单元台账（33 个单元）/ Near-side unit ledger (33 units)
purpose_zh: 专业团队可直接接手的交接资产：逐单元给出近端客厅几何、24 小时通道长度、主导障碍、拟配设施、责任角色与判定标准。
purpose_en: Handover asset for professional teams: per-unit near-side room geometry, 24h passage length, main obstacle, proposed facility, responsible role and acceptance test.
unit_rule_zh: 每 300 米一个单元；规则是「每 300 米一格」而非「一共 33 格」，官方范围外扩时单元数 33→N，台账口径不失效。
unit_rule_en: One unit per 300 m; the rule is one cell per 300 m, not 33 cells in total, so the ledger survives an expansion of the official boundary (33 -> N).
recompute_trigger_zh: 官方 polygon 与公园边界面发布后 30 天内整体复算并提交新版本。
recompute_trigger_en: Recalculated as a whole and resubmitted within 30 days after the official polygon and park edge face are published.

units.test_en: Exit to ground floor within 5 min
